title: Architecture: E-Commerce Multichannel Messaging Analysis
description: Analysis pipeline for 10M+ e-commerce direct messages across email, mobile_push, and web_push channels with conversion funnel analysis, customer segmentation (Champions/Potential/Loss), and ML purchase prediction.

nodes.label: Messages Dataset
nodes.description: 10M messages with channel, campaign, timestamp, open/click/purchase events (Apr 2021 - Apr 2023)

nodes.label: Campaigns Dataset
nodes.description: 1,907 campaigns with type, provider, audience size metadata

nodes.label: Data Cleaning
nodes.description: Memory optimization (boolean encoding, datetime conversion), handling 100% empty category, 92.6% missing platform

nodes.label: Feature Engineering
nodes.description: Duration (open-to-click), engagement flags, temporal features, IQR outlier removal

nodes.label: Customer Segmentation
nodes.description: Behavioral segments: Champions (opened+clicked+purchased), Potential (opened+clicked), Loss (no engagement)

nodes.label: KL Divergence Validation
nodes.description: Validate segment separation with KL=0.127 between Champions and Potential

nodes.label: Logistic Regression
nodes.description: Interpretable baseline with L1/L2 regularization, coefficient analysis

nodes.label: Random Forest
nodes.description: 85.7% accuracy purchase prediction with feature importance ranking

nodes.label: Class Imbalance Handler
nodes.description: RandomUnderSampler for 0.12% purchase rate minority class

nodes.label: EDA Visualizations
nodes.description: Channel comparison, platform breakdown, temporal patterns, funnel visualization
